core_claim: Skill variety, task identity, task significance, autonomy, and feedback create psychological states that raise internal motivation, satisfaction, and performance.
Job demands drive burnout through a health-impairment process, job resources drive engagement through a motivational process, and resources buffer demands.
business_use: Burnout prevention, engagement surveys, hybrid work design

core_claim: People strive to protect valued resources, resource loss weighs more than equivalent gain, and losses and gains tend to spiral.
business_use: Change management and targeted well-being support

core_claim: Work events trigger emotional reactions that drive spontaneous behaviour directly and considered behaviour through job attitudes.
business_use: Service work design and recovery from negative customer events

core_claim: Leaders form exchange relationships of different quality with different followers, and high-quality exchanges improve performance and attitudes.
business_use: Manager training, onboarding, and team management

core_claim: Leaders who articulate a vision, role model, stimulate thinking, and attend to individuals raise motivation beyond exchange-based incentives.
Leaders motivate by clarifying paths to goals and increasing rewards, with the best behaviour depending on task and follower characteristics.
business_use: Situational coaching and matching leadership style to teams

core_claim: Employees hold beliefs about reciprocal promises, and perceived breach reduces trust, commitment, and effort even without a legal breach.
business_use: Change communication, employer branding, return-to-office policy

core_claim: Distributive, procedural, interpersonal, and informational fairness each shape reactions, and fair process softens unfavourable outcomes.
business_use: Layoffs, performance appraisal, and pay decisions

core_claim: Commitment combines desire (affective), need (continuance), and obligation (normative) to stay, and only affective commitment reliably raises effort.
business_use: Retention strategy and design of deferred pay

core_claim: Compatibility between a person and the job, group, supervisor, or organization predicts satisfaction, commitment, and retention.
business_use: Selection, culture-fit assessment, realistic job previews

core_claim: Skills are investments, workers pay for general training while firms and workers share the costs and returns of firm-specific training.
business_use: Training investment and retention of skilled employees

core_claim: When pay depends on rank, the prize spread motivates effort, so pay jumps grow up the hierarchy, at the cost of sabotage and reduced cooperation.
business_use: Executive pay, promotion systems, and sales contests
